scope: All1117 queries and5405 physical references; SHA deduplicated ranks.
regional_definition: Keep template tokens plus weighted/selected visual tokens. Normalize by sum of query weights; use all original valid reference tokens. Empty visual regions retain templates and are flagged.
random_control: Ten fixed seeds, per-query SHA-derived generator; sample same number of visual tokens as center subject mask; retain identical template tokens.
selection: Choose center mixing weight using validation-package macro Top1 then macro MRR then smaller weight. Repeat for image, original fusion, corrected-presence fusion, numeric fusion. Apply that weight to all random masks. Other mask definitions are sensitivity analyses, not candidates for selection.
fusion: Image mixture with fresh per-query population z score and unchanged text z-score; also fixed original image mean/std to isolate normalization.
ocr_intervention: Remove one most-negative or all negative OCR lines for baseline best-positive vs best-negative pair; ten deterministic same-count random deletions; original BM25, corrected presence and numeric presence; frozen reference corpus and IDF. Full-gallery reranking, both fixed and recomputed text normalization.
oracle_warning: OCR line selection uses truth and is an oracle diagnostic, not a deployable method. Subject boxes are human-reviewed supervision. No test tuning; historical splits already inspected, not a fresh blind test.
evidence_boundary: Frozen readout interventions test score aggregation sufficiency, not image causality or universal presence/absence of encoder identity information.
